description: This Java class 'ThingsPersistenceStreamingActorCreator' creates and manages Akka actors responsible for streaming persisted 'things' data, including event streaming and snapshot streaming actors. It defines methods to instantiate these actors with specific configurations and maintains constants for actor naming and ID pattern matching.

classes.name: ThingsPersistenceStreamingActorCreator
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to create and start streaming actors for persisted 'things'. It also holds constants for actor names and ID pattern matching.

methods.name: startEventStreamingActor
methods.description: Creates and starts an event streaming actor with a specified cache size and actor creation function.

methods.name: startSnapshotStreamingActor
methods.description: Creates and starts a snapshot streaming actor using a provided actor creation function.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Creates a 'ThingTag' from a 'PidWithSeqNr' object by extracting the entity ID and sequence number.

methods.name: createPidWithSeqNr
methods.description: Constructs a 'PidWithSeqNr' object from an 'EntityIdWithRevision' by converting entity ID to PID format and including revision.

methods.name: pid2EntityId
methods.description: Converts a PID string into a 'ThingId' by removing the prefix pattern.

methods.name: entityId2Pid
methods.description: Converts an 'EntityId' into a PID string by prepending the persistence ID prefix.
